# Lockheed Martin shares slip after Bernstein downgrade

September 3, 2026 -- Shares of Lockheed Martin fell 2% on Wednesday after Bernstein downgraded the defense contractor to Market Perform from Outperform, citing F-35 margin pressure, and cut its price target to $480 from $520.

Separately, Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $575 from $560 on August 12, 2026, pointing to missile demand and the record backlog.

The company announced an agreement to acquire Ultra Maritime for $1.5 billion in July.
